description: This file defines ML event classes and a trait for logging and handling ML-related events in Apache Spark's MLlib, including events for transformation, fitting, loading, and saving ML models and components.

classes.name: MLEvent
classes.description: Sealed trait representing ML events, supporting before/after events for transformations, fitting, loading, and saving.

classes.name: TransformStart
classes.description: Event fired before a Transformer.transform operation.

classes.name: TransformEnd
classes.description: Event fired after a Transformer.transform operation.

classes.name: FitStart
classes.description: Event fired before an Estimator.fit operation.

classes.name: FitEnd
classes.description: Event fired after an Estimator.fit operation.

classes.name: MLEvents
classes.description: Trait providing methods to log and handle ML events, including context managers for fitting, transforming, loading, and saving.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs an MLEvent at debug level.

methods.name: withFitEvent
methods.description: Handles logging and posting events around an Estimator.fit operation.

methods.name: withTransformEvent
methods.description: Handles logging and posting events around a Transformer.transform operation.

methods.name: withLoadInstanceEvent
methods.description: Handles logging and posting events around MLReader.load.

methods.name: withSaveInstanceEvent
methods.description: Handles logging and posting events around MLWriter.save.
